# PLLM

Release: 0.1.0
Build: sha256:65f4ad316621284cc28b60b1a825a6d9c6d1f108cbb5032aee0983de1e5c4966

Private LLM inference documentation. Public weights; provider follows the protocol.

- [Get started](https://pllm.run/learn/start/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/start.md)): Install PLLM, inspect a private inference plan, and run the local development benchmark.
- [Installation](https://pllm.run/learn/start/installation/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/start/installation.md)): Install the Python package and verify the CLI without loading a model or contacting a service.
- [Inspect a private inference plan](https://pllm.run/learn/start/first-private-request/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/start/first-private-request.md)): Define a reproducible experiment, lower a semantic model plan, and check its execution coverage.
- [Configuration](https://pllm.run/sdk/configuration/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/configuration.md)): Load, inspect, and export a reproducible PLLM experiment configuration.
- [Model plans](https://pllm.run/sdk/plans/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/plans.md)): Lower a model configuration, add components, and inspect compiler coverage.
- [Components](https://pllm.run/sdk/components/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/components.md)): Inspect versioned capabilities and apply compatible components to a model plan.
- [Build](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build.md)): Define a reproducible PLLM system from configuration, models, components, and research methods.
- [Models](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/model-adapters/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/model-adapters.md)): Turn model-family configuration into a shared decoder plan.
- [Research methods and composition](https://pllm.run/research/recipes/build-method/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/research/recipes/build-method.md)): Turn a published method into a versioned component and a recorded plan change.
- [Understand](https://pllm.run/learn/understand/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/understand.md)): Understand PLLM's architecture, trust boundaries, privacy assumptions, and evidence model.
- [Architecture](https://pllm.run/learn/understand/architecture/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/understand/architecture.md)): Understand PLLM's plans, runtime stages, role ownership, and side effects.
- [Trust boundary](https://pllm.run/learn/understand/trust-boundary/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/understand/trust-boundary.md)): Understand what the client, preparation service, inference service, and operators can access.
- [Privacy and assurance semantics](https://pllm.run/learn/understand/privacy-assurance/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/understand/privacy-assurance.md)): State a specific privacy claim and interpret the evidence that applies to it.
- [Evidence and claim taxonomy](https://pllm.run/learn/understand/evidence-claims/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/understand/evidence-claims.md)): Separate a design contract, an implementation, its evidence, and a publication claim.
- [Research APIs](https://pllm.run/sdk/research/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/research.md)): Use the Python SDK to benchmark plans, run scoped assurance checks, and produce immutable evidence records.
- [Benchmark](https://pllm.run/sdk/research/benchmark/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/research/benchmark.md)): Run scoped Python benchmarks and understand what the development dashboard does not measure.
- [Compare](https://pllm.run/research/recipes/compare/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/research/recipes/compare.md)): Compare runs with matching inputs and report every relevant cost and uncertainty.
- [Reproduce](https://pllm.run/research/recipes/reproduce/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/research/recipes/reproduce.md)): Compare an independent PLLM implementation with the published method it follows.
- [Assure](https://pllm.run/sdk/research/assure/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/research/assure.md)): Run a defined assurance check and report exactly what its result supports.
- [Operate](https://pllm.run/sdk/operate/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/operate.md)): Assign client, preparation, and inference responsibilities without weakening the privacy design.
- [Client boundary](https://pllm.run/sdk/operate/client-boundary/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/operate/client-boundary.md)): Understand which data and runtime state must stay with the client.
- [Provider roles](https://pllm.run/sdk/operate/provider-roles/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/operate/provider-roles.md)): Understand the responsibilities of deployment operators, preparation services, and inference services.
- [Deployment](https://pllm.run/sdk/operate/deployment/status/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/operate/deployment/status.md)): Understand current deployment support, required role placement, and missing orchestration.
- [Reference](https://pllm.run/sdk/reference/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/reference.md)): Look up exact CLI commands, Python APIs, schemas, components, research records, and current support.
- [CLI reference](https://pllm.run/cli/reference/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/cli/reference.md)): Exact commands, arguments, and help text from the installed PLLM CLI.

- [Method implementations](https://pllm.run/research/methods/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/research/methods.md)): Understand the difference between a published method and PLLM's independent implementation of it.

- [Research evidence](https://pllm.run/research/evidence/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/research/evidence.md)): Understand which evidence supports fidelity, performance, privacy, and deployment claims.

- [Agents](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute/agents/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute/agents.md)): Find the code and records used for implementation, research, and reproduction work.

- [Research map](https://pllm.run/research/recipes/agent-map/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/research/recipes/agent-map.md)): Trace a source through clean-room code, plans, evidence, and publication review.
- [Assurance](https://pllm.run/sdk/research/assurance/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/research/assurance.md)): Evaluate a specific privacy, integrity, numeric, implementation, or deployment claim.
- [Benchmarks](https://pllm.run/sdk/research/benchmarks/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/research/benchmarks.md)): Measure PLLM systems with reproducible records and compare only equivalent runs.
- [Command-line interface](https://pllm.run/cli/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/cli.md)): Inspect PLLM records and run local benchmarks from the terminal.
- [Compiler](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/compiler/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/compiler.md)): Learn how PLLM turns a model plan and component choices into a checked execution plan.
- [Add a category](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute/add-a-category/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute/add-a-category.md)): Extend the semantic component graph when an existing category cannot express a real contract.
- [Component standard](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute/component-standard/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute/component-standard.md)): Required identity, lifecycle, representation, role, capability, evidence, and limitation fields.
- [Contribute](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute.md)): Add a model, component, research method, or evidence record without creating a one-off runtime path.
- [Native plugin ABI](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute/native-plugin-abi/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute/native-plugin-abi.md)): Boundary requirements for future independently distributed native capability providers.
- [Publish a provider](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute/publish-a-provider/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute/publish-a-provider.md)): Expose a component implementation without importing it during core discovery.
- [Upstreaming](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute/upstreaming/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute/upstreaming.md)): Move validated research work into maintained semantic and runtime components.
- [Conversions](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/conversions/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/conversions.md)): Learn how values move between numeric formats, layouts, and owners.
- [Deployment](https://pllm.run/sdk/operate/deployment/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/operate/deployment.md)): Learn how to assign PLLM roles to authenticated services without changing privacy assumptions.
- [Kernels](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/kernels/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/kernels.md)): Understand PLLM's native integer matrix kernels, memory costs, and CPU requirements.
- [Arithmetic and Boolean garbling](https://pllm.run/learn/arithmetic-and-boolean-garbling/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/arithmetic-and-boolean-garbling.md)): Compare arithmetic and Boolean garbling without treating one primitive as a complete private runtime.
- [Learn](https://pllm.run/learn/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn.md)): Understand PLLM's private inference runtime, research harness, trust assumptions, and evidence.
- [Masked linear inference](https://pllm.run/learn/masked-linear-inference/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/masked-linear-inference.md)): Follow seeded one-time masks through offline correction and online matrix evaluation.
- [Numeric semantics and model quality](https://pllm.run/learn/numeric-semantics-and-model-quality/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/numeric-semantics-and-model-quality.md)): Understand how integer arithmetic affects correctness and model output quality.
- [Parties and offline work](https://pllm.run/learn/parties-and-offline-work/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/parties-and-offline-work.md)): Learn what each party does before and during a private inference request.
- [Privacy and threat models](https://pllm.run/learn/privacy-and-threat-models/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/privacy-and-threat-models.md)): Learn what PLLM protects, what each party can see, and which trust assumptions still apply.
- [Reading research and evidence](https://pllm.run/learn/reading-research-and-evidence/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/reading-research-and-evidence.md)): Learn how PLLM connects papers, clean-room implementations, measurements, and publication claims.
- [Metrics](https://pllm.run/research/records/metrics/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/research/records/metrics.md)): Choose clear performance, resource, quality, and privacy measurements for a PLLM experiment.
- [Gemma 4](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/models/gemma4/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/models/gemma4.md)): Variant-parameterized text-decoder lowering for exact Gemma 4 E2B and E4B configurations.
- [Models](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/models/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/models.md)): See which model configurations PLLM can describe and what model support does not yet include.
- [Phi-4 mini](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/models/phi4-mini/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/models/phi4-mini.md)): Fused-projection and LongRoPE semantic lowering for Phi-4-mini-instruct.
- [Qwen2](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/models/qwen2/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/models/qwen2.md)): Dense Qwen2 semantic lowering and its present execution boundary.
- [Qwen3 and mini-coder](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/models/qwen3/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/models/qwen3.md)): Dense Qwen3 lowering with explicit head width and Q/K normalization.
- [Qwen3.5](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/models/qwen35/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/models/qwen35.md)): Hybrid full-attention and gated-delta semantic lowering for Qwen3.5-4B.
- [Numerics](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/numerics/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/numerics.md)): Understand PLLM's integer arithmetic, quantization, rounding, approximation, and overflow checks.
- [SiLU activation](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/operators/activation-silu/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/operators/activation-silu.md)): Compile and evaluate PLLM's bounded experimental Q7 SiLU component.
- [Operators](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/operators/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/operators.md)): Learn how PLLM describes model operations independently of model family and runtime.
- [Projection and rotary variants](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/operators/projection-rotary/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/operators/projection-rotary.md)): Represent fused projections, tensor slices, head widths, and rotary position rules.
- [Stateful recurrence](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/operators/stateful-recurrence/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/operators/stateful-recurrence.md)): Represent convolution and recurrent state in a hybrid decoder plan.
- [Pipeline](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline.md)): Combine model, privacy protocol, preparation, runtime, and deployment choices in one configuration.
- [Preparation](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/preparation/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/preparation.md)): Prepare one-time masked material before a private inference request starts.
- [Arithmetic garbling](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/protocols/garbling/arithmetic/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/protocols/garbling/arithmetic.md)): Mixed-modulus labels and projection gates over bounded arithmetic values.
- [Half-gates](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/protocols/garbling/half-gates/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/protocols/garbling/half-gates.md)): Boolean AND-gate representation and the obligations surrounding free-XOR circuit execution.
- [Garbling](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/protocols/garbling/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/protocols/garbling.md)): Reference arithmetic and Boolean garbling components with explicit maturity and composition boundaries.
- [Lookup tables](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/protocols/garbling/lookup-tables/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/protocols/garbling/lookup-tables.md)): Bounded function tables with explicit domains, indexing, leakage, and material size.
- [Weighted path](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/protocols/garbling/weighted-path/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/protocols/garbling/weighted-path.md)): Decision-path representations for bounded piecewise or tree-structured secure evaluation.
- [Protocols](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/protocols/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/protocols.md)): See how PLLM defines parties, messages, privacy assumptions, and failure behavior.
- [Masked linear](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/protocols/masked-linear/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/protocols/masked-linear.md)): Prepared public-weight linear inference with seeded one-time masks and committed inventory.
- [Research workflows](https://pllm.run/research/recipes/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/research/recipes.md)): Build, reproduce, compare, and review private-inference research with explicit stop rules.
- [Native reference](https://pllm.run/sdk/reference/native/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/reference/native.md)): Rust crates, the Python binding, data ownership, threading, and ABI support.
- [Python reference](https://pllm.run/sdk/reference/python/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/reference/python.md)): The installed pllm namespace and its generated public API inventory.
- [Representations](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/representations/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/representations.md)): Understand how PLLM records a value's format, owner, bounds, and encoding.
- [Experiments](https://pllm.run/research/recipes/experiments/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/research/recipes/experiments.md)): Design reproducible experiments with fixed plans, comparable runs, and recorded failures.
- [Reimplemented papers](https://pllm.run/research/papers/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/research/papers.md)): Trace published private-inference methods to their independent PLLM components, evidence, and current limitations.
- [Evidence and records](https://pllm.run/research/records/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/research/records.md)): Keep sources, methods, implementations, plans, evidence, assurance, and claims independently reviewable.
- [Reproductions](https://pllm.run/research/recipes/reproductions/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/research/recipes/reproductions.md)): Reimplement published methods independently in PLLM's Python and Rust stack.
- [Runtime](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/runtime/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/runtime.md)): Understand which live state a PLLM runtime owns and how it differs from a reproducible plan.
- [Python SDK](https://pllm.run/sdk/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk.md)): Plan models, compose research methods, and use supported PLLM runtimes from Python.
- [Search](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/search/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/search.md)): Compare compatible system designs against explicit resource, quality, and assurance limits.
- [Run the local development benchmark](https://pllm.run/learn/start/first-local-benchmark/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/learn/start/first-local-benchmark.md)): Run the real PLLM roles on one machine and understand what the result does and does not measure.
